description: Behavioural test cases for the in-app assistant, organised by interaction context. Each case provides the state to simulate, the trigger message, the pass criteria for the assistant's reply, and category-specific metadata. Worked example for the fictional Example Notes app — replace with your unit's case library.

note_actions.scenario: Assistant creates a note when asked
note_actions.sessionContent: Logged-in member on home_screen with an empty notes list. Assistant opened via assistant_open_button.
note_actions.keySignal: Create a note called "Groceries" with milk and eggs
note_actions.assistantDebrief: Creates exactly one note titled "Groceries" containing milk and eggs, confirms in assistant_action_confirmation, and the note is visible under tab_notes. The reply describes only what was actually done.
note_actions.notes: Verify on tab_notes after the reply — a confirmation message alone is not a pass (see guardrail claimed_action_not_performed).
